response: This function computes the length of the longest common subsequence (LCS) between two sequences `a` and `b` using bottom-up dynamic programming. It builds a 2D table `dp` where `dp[i][j]` stores the LCS length for the prefixes `a[:i]` and `b[:j]`, filling each cell by extending the diagonal when characters match or taking the maximum of the left and top cells otherwise.
